title: The Unexpected Locker
author: Edmund Sterling
blurb: Marguerite Crane, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
